description: Highways Agency network journey time and traffic flow data is a data set deposited in University of Glasgow by the authors named in the record. This data series provides average journey time, speed and traffic flow information for 15-minute periods since April 2009 on all morotways and 'A' roads managed by the Highways Agency, known as the Strategic Road Network, in England.
